source_trace.selection_rule: Only items with non-empty code values (D.1–D.6 series) are canonical catalog items. The remaining 118 records are per-booking one-offs (fuel, specific transfers, refunds) and are excluded.
source_trace.notes: Added is_default_jvto field per real API data. JVTO defaults: D.2 Transport Allowance, D.1 Mineral Water, D.3 T-shirt, D.4 Toll & Parking. D.5 Ferry and D.6 Ferry-Guide are route-specific (not default — only added when itinerary includes Bali).

catalog_items.name: Transport Allowance
catalog_items.notes: Per-trip transport allowance for crew. Always included for JVTO orders.

catalog_items.name: Mineral Water
catalog_items.notes: 1 pack per 3 pax (rounded up). Always included for JVTO orders.

catalog_items.name: T-shirt
catalog_items.notes: One shirt per guest. is_default_jvto=true — must be included in all JVTO expense calculations.

catalog_items.name: Toll & Parking
catalog_items.notes: Flat per-trip toll and parking fee. Always included for JVTO orders.

catalog_items.name: Ferry Ticket
catalog_items.notes: Ketapang–Gilimanuk ferry, per person. Route-specific — only added when Bali (dest=3) is in the itinerary.

catalog_items.name: Ferry-Guide
catalog_items.notes: Guide fee for ferry crossing. Route-specific — only added when Bali (dest=3) is in the itinerary.

catalog_items.name: Mineral Water
catalog_items.notes: Per-person mineral water for TWT (lower unit price)

catalog_items.name: Toll & Parking Malang
catalog_items.notes: Toll route via Malang (longer route, higher cost)
